[CONTRIBUTION EVENT]
- Type: Time (Minutes)
- Amount: 20
- Description: Mercado Libre shipping address — form field mapping, CEP verification, and address filing
  
  Pull requests (GitHub evidence):
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/agentic_ai_context/pull/1050
  
  Details:
  Handled Gary's Mercado Libre "Add an address" form for the Ilhéus, Bahia shipping address (Av. Soares Lopes 1590, Edf. Mansão Dom Eduardo, Ap 801).
  
  Work performed:
  - Mapped the free-text address to Mercado Libre's discrete form fields (ZIP code / Street / Number / Additional information / Recipient), since ML's validator splits número, complemento and bairro differently from how the address was written.
  - Caught that the building name ("Edf. Mansão Dom Eduardo") was placed in the Street/Avenue field — ML matches street names against the postal database, so extra tokens there cause address-validation and delivery-label printing errors. Advised moving it to the complement field. (Converged with Gemini's advice; added the CEP correction it missed.)
  - Verified the CEP for Av. Soares Lopes, which splits by house number: Centro 45653-005 up to nº 774/775; Cidade Nova 45652-065 from nº 776 onward. Nº 1590 falls in the Cidade Nova range, but the saved record carries CEP 45653005 (the Centro code) with bairro "Cidade Nova" — flagged as inconsistent for label generation.
  - Read back the shipped screenshot and reported exactly what the image contained (fields, autofilled ZIP 45653-005, auto-resolved bairro Centro, street field containing the building name) rather than relying on the stale pasted text block.
  - Filed the structured address payload to agentic_ai_context/references/SHIPPING_ADDRESSES_REFERENCE.md (PR #1050, merged), then verified Gary's manual entry landed in the Main Ledger "Contributors contact information" sheet, column U ("Mailing Address"), and reported the exact row (U241) plus two open flags: the value sits on the Matheus Reis row while the payload names Zhiwen Teh as recipient, and the CEP/bairro mismatch above.
  
  No writes to the ledger or sheet were made by the autopilot for this task.
- Contributor(s): Sophia Truesight
- TDG Issued: 33.33
- Attached Filename: N/A
- Destination Contribution File Location: N/A
